declarations.name: AuiCollapsible

inputs.name: content
inputs.description: Region content; strings are rendered as text.

inputs.name: open
inputs.description: Initial state; with update(), sets the state.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Blocks toggling (aria-disabled; the trigger stays focusable).

inputs.name: headingLevel
inputs.description: Wrap the trigger in a heading of this level.

inputs.name: variant
inputs.description: plain: text trigger; bordered: full-width trigger in a bordered surface.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The user toggled the content: { open }.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Disclosure: a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls shows and hides one content region.

limitations: Hidden content is not found by the browser's find in page.
The open state is not remembered across page loads (store it in the application if needed).
